flags.note: The stem says 'Based on the information in paragraph 1', but paragraph 1 gives only the rate (15 degrees per hour). It never says which direction an earlier or later local time indicates. The 30-degree size follows from the passage, but telling A (east) from B (west) needs outside knowledge: Earth turns eastward, so places to the west have earlier clock time. A passage-only reader cannot pick between A and B. Fix: add a sentence to P1 (e.g., 'a ship whose local time was behind home-port time had sailed west'), or make the answer choices differ only in degrees (for example, 2/15/30/60 degrees west).
